turns.text: 我家90平，预算12万，客厅想铺木地板，地暖不做。你们量房一般多久？
turns.expect: Explain current 90-minute guidance with appointment qualification; no draft or handoff.

turns.text: 那我需要整天待在家里吗？先别联系设计师。
turns.expect: Resolve duration follow-up; no all-day requirement, no booking promise, no write or handoff.

turns.text: 把我刚才说的整理留一下，之后再确认。
turns.expect: Persist pending draft with area, 12万, wood flooring and negative heating; not confirmed.

turns.text: 预算改成10万，客厅换瓷砖，其余照旧。也告诉我量房前要准备什么。
turns.expect: Persist budget and flooring correction, retain area/negative heating; answer preparation from enterprise source in the same reply.

turns.text: 那你刚才说的时长现在还能作准吗？我的地暖打算没变吧？
turns.expect: No withdrawn duration in input or output; explain unavailable current policy, retain no-heating intention; no writes.

turns.text: 算了，预算还是按12万，瓷砖留着。先帮我改回来，设计师暂时不用找。
turns.expect: Persist restored 12万, preserve tile/area/no-heating, no handoff.

turns.text: 现在帮我找位设计师接着聊吧，别把我的手机号给他。
turns.expect: Real waiting handoff only; no contact consent or phone sharing; preserve draft.

turns.text: 我还没准备好，刚才找设计师的事取消吧。已经保存的需求别动。
turns.expect: Real cancelled handoff and AI mode restored, no new draft or changes; do not claim an unperformed cancellation.
